model_summary: Binary classification model predicting whether a bank client subscribes to a term deposit based on marketing campaign contact attributes.
intended_use: Demonstration of the Atlas DataFlow multi-dataset publication capability. Predicts whether a client will subscribe to a term deposit based on demographic and campaign contact features.

output.positive_class_meaning: client subscribes to a term deposit

limitations: Model is assembled for demonstration purposes within the Atlas DataFlow M15 second dataset candidate build.
Predictions reflect patterns in the training dataset and should not be used for production banking decisions without independent validation.
No sensitive personal data, raw model weights, or private training pipeline details are included in this public artifact.
data_notes: Public-safe model card for the bank-marketing release-20260620-002 candidate. Raw training data, private preprocessing steps, and model internals are excluded.
